posts.title: Press-on nails vs extensions: which should you pick?
posts.excerpt: A sample blog post shown in preview. Write real posts from the Blog screen in the owner app.
posts.body:
## Press-ons

Reusable, quick to apply at home, and great for a weekend or an event.

## Extensions

Gel-X, acrylic and PolyGel last 3 to 4 weeks and are done by us at your home.

posts.title: How to make your gel extensions last longer
posts.excerpt: Five habits that keep your set looking fresh for weeks. A sample post for the preview.
posts.body:
1. Wear gloves for dishes and cleaning
2. Use cuticle oil every night
3. Don't use your nails as tools
4. Book your refill on time
5. Never peel off a lifting nail; message us instead
